name: Scout
description: Every morning, look for problems and opportunities and report each one with evidence.

config.title: Scout for problems
config.text: Look in PostHog for error spikes, failing funnels, rage and dead clicks, metrics moving against goals, and recurring survey or support themes. Prefer two strong findings to ten weak ones.

name: Daily brief
description: Every morning at 09:00 UTC, write what changed and what needs you.

config.title: Daily brief
config.text: Review the last day's linked sources. Report each material change and what needs attention.

name: Weekly goals
description: Every Monday at 09:00 UTC, report progress against the goals.

config.text: Check each goal against its latest measurements and report material progress or setbacks.

name: Log, don't inbox
description: Keep a note of each message without adding it to the inbox.
